prompt:
Create a BRAND NEW production sprite sheet for a medieval fantasy RPG enemy: Señor del Abismo (senor_abismo). Match its polished hand-painted fantasy RPG aesthetic and grounded adult anatomy, crisp dark outlines, detailed textured materials, warm highlights, soft volumetric shading, readable small-scale silhouette. ART DIRECTION: MORE SERIOUS, exactly aligned with the playable character reference. Adult humanoids use about 4 to 4.5 head units of height, smaller natural heads and eyes, longer credible torso/legs/forearms, restrained stern hostile expressions. No chibi proportions, toy/mascot look, baby features, stubby limbs, cartoon grin or exaggerated comedy. Nonhuman creatures use credible species anatomy with the same painted material finish. Not photorealism or horror. Transparent empty background. Every subject entirely within its own equal cell, generous empty padding between figures. Figures must occupy no more than 65% of cell height, with generous transparent padding. No overlap between cells, no cropped horns, tails, wings or weapons.

ROW 2 (middle): HURT four frames, neutral alert, flinch from a blow, strongest recoil, recovering; no blood, no impact star, no floating effects.

All carried weapons/accessories remain visibly held in EVERY pose including blink, hurt and dodge. All sixteen figures SAME identity, costume, equipment, colors, body size and camera scale. Side-view three-quarter camera facing RIGHT, matching the player reference. For this creature keep its natural anatomy, not a humanoid costume unless specified. Anchor the support point consistently in all cells, stable idle. ROW 4 (bottom): DODGE four frames, alert preparation, evasive duck or sidestep/backward lean appropriate to the species, lowest evasive pose, return to guard. Distinct from hurt and attack. No ghost copies or motion streaks.
Keep every frame FULL BODY and the same zoom. Transparent background with real alpha, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadows, no captions, no frame borders, no UI. This is high-detail NEW art, not enlarged old pixel art.
